text:
NEEDS_FIX: YES
<assessment>Across both source views, the café has a tall timber-clad primary volume over a white ground floor, a dominant pitched roof, separate low canopies over the entry and corner glazing, and a lower white annex at the rear/right with its own shallow roof. The model captures the main volume, glazing and terrace, but omits that annex, leaving the primary box as the only building mass.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="roof">problem: The source’s attached rear/right annex and its distinct lower roof are missing from the model roof and oblique views.
action: Add the annex locally behind/right of the existing café mass, with a separate shallow roof at the source’s lower height; preserve the matching primary volume and roof.</issue>
<keep>Primary tall timber-clad volume above the white ground floor.</keep>
<keep>Corner glazing with its projecting timber braces and low canopy.</keep>
<keep>Raised terrace and stepped entry platform.</keep>
